title: Paired statistics and current consumer seams

consumer_findings.ml: ooRexx ML dev11 contains private mean/variance and covariance-like PCA numerics; model/training/journal semantics remain ML-owned.
consumer_findings.vision: Vision3D dev9 native motion computes mean/variance/spread and private sqrt; frame cadence, geometry and motion interpretation remain Vision-owned.
